build.beforeDevCommand: sh -c "if [ -f frontend/package.json ]; then npm --prefix frontend run dev; elif [ -f ../frontend/package.json ]; then npm --prefix ../frontend run dev; elif [ -f package.json ]; then npm run dev; else echo 'frontend package.json não encontrado' && exit 1; fi"
build.beforeBuildCommand: sh -c "if [ -f frontend/package.json ]; then npm --prefix frontend run build; elif [ -f ../frontend/package.json ]; then npm --prefix ../frontend run build; elif [ -f package.json ]; then npm run build; else echo 'frontend package.json não encontrado' && exit 1; fi"
